verses.text: Di one wey dwell for di secret place of di Most High go abide under di shadow of di Almighty.
I go talk of di Lord say, “Na im be my refuge and my fortress, my God, wey I trust.”
Because e go deliver you from di snare of di fowler and from di deadly pestilence.
E go cover you with im feathers, and under im wings you go take refuge. Im faithfulness na shield and wall.
You no go fear di terror of di night, or di arrow wey dey fly for day,
or di pestilence wey dey waka for darkness, or di destruction wey dey waste for noon.
1,000 go fall for your side, and 10,000 for your right hand, but e no go come near you.
Only with your eyes you go look and see di reward of di wicked.
Because you don make di Lord your refuge, di Most High your dwelling place.
No evil go happen to you, and no plague go come near your tent.
Because e go command im angels to guard you for all your ways.
Dem go bear you up for dem hands, so dat you no go strike your foot against stone.
You go tread on di lion and di cobra. You go trample di young lion and di serpent under foot.
“Because e hold fast to me with love, so I go deliver am. I go set am on high, because e know my name.
E go call on me, and I go answer am. I go dey with am for trouble. I go rescue am and honor am.
I go satisfy am with long life and show am my salvation.”

chapters.title: A Psalm. A song for di Sabbath day.

verses.text: E good to give thanks to di Lord, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
to proclaim your faithful love for di morning and your faithfulness every night,
with di ten stringed instrument, with di harp, and with di melody of di lyre.
Because you, Lord, don make me glad through your work. I go shout for joy for di works of your hands.
How great your works dey, Lord! Your thoughts dey very deep.
Senseless man no know, and fool no understand dis:
when di wicked spring up like grass, and all di workers of iniquity flourish, na so dem go dey destroyed forever.
But you, Lord, dey on high forevermore.
Because look, your enemies, Lord, because look, your enemies go perish. All di workers of iniquity go scatter.
But you don lift up my horn like di horn of wild ox. I don dey anointed with fresh oil.
My eye don see my enemies fall. My ears don hear di wicked wey rise up against me.
Di righteous go flourish like palm tree. E go grow like cedar for Lebanon.
Dem wey dem plant for di house of di Lord go flourish for di courts of our God.
Dem go still bear fruit for old age. Dem go dey full of sap and green,
to show say di Lord dey upright. Na im be my rock, and no unrighteousness dey inside am.
Di Lord reign! E don clothe imself with majesty. Di Lord don clothe imself with strength. E don gird imself with am. Di world dey firmly established. E no go shake.
Your throne dey established from of old. You dey from everlasting.
Di floods don lift up, Lord. Di floods don lift up dem voice. Di floods lift up dem waves.
Above di voices of many waters, di mighty breakers of di sea, di Lord on high dey mighty.
Your statutes dey very sure. Holiness befit your house, Lord, forevermore.
Lord God, to whom vengeance belong, God, to whom vengeance belong, shine out.
Rise up, you judge of di earth. Give di proud wetin dem deserve.
Lord, how long go di wicked, how long go di wicked triumph?
Dem dey pour out arrogant words. All di workers of iniquity dey boast.
Dem dey crush your people, Lord, and afflict your inheritance.
Dem dey kill di widow and di stranger and murder di orphan.
Dem dey talk say, “Di Lord no go see, and di God of Jacob no go consider.”
Consider, una senseless among di people. Una fools, when una go get wisdom?
Di one wey plant di ear no go hear? Di one wey form di eye no go see?
Di one wey correct di nations no go punish? Di one wey teach man knowledge,
di Lord know di thoughts of man, say dem na breath.
Blessed na di man wey you correct, Lord, and teach out of your law,
so dat you go give am rest from days of trouble, until dem dig pit for di wicked.
Because di Lord no go forsake im people. E no go abandon im inheritance.
Because judgment go return to righteousness, and all di upright for heart go follow am.
Who go rise up for me against di wicked? Who go stand up for me against di workers of iniquity?
If di Lord no help me, my soul go soon dwell for di silence of death.
When I talk say, “My foot slip,” your faithful love, Lord, hold me up.
When my anxious thoughts plenty inside me, your comforts dey cheer my soul.
Throne of wickedness fit join with you, wey dey make trouble by law?
Dem dey gang up against di life of di righteous and condemn innocent blood.
But di Lord don be my high tower, and my God di rock of my refuge.
E don bring back on dem dem own iniquity and go destroy dem for dem own wickedness. Di Lord our God go destroy dem.
Oh come, make we sing to di Lord. Make we shout aloud to di rock of our salvation.
Make we come before im presence with thanksgiving. Make we shout aloud to am with songs of praise.
Because di Lord na great God, and great King above all gods.
For im hand na di deep places of di earth. Di heights of di mountains na im own also.
Di sea na im own, and e make am. Im hands also form di dry land.
Oh come, make we worship and bow down. Make we kneel before di Lord our Maker,
because na im be our God, and we be di people of im pasture and di sheep of im hand. Today, if una go hear im voice,
“No harden una heart, as for Meribah, as for di day of Massah for di wilderness,
when una papa dem test me and prove me, and dem see my work.
For 40 years I dey grieved with dat generation, and I talk say, ‘Na people wey dey go astray for dem heart, and dem no know my ways.’
So I swear for my anger, ‘Dem no go enter my rest.’”
Oh sing to di Lord new song! Sing to di Lord, all di earth.
Sing to di Lord. Bless im name. Proclaim im salvation from day to day.
Declare im glory among di nations, im marvelous works among all peoples.
Because di Lord dey great, and e suppose get plenty praise. E suppose dey feared above all gods.
Because all di gods of di peoples na idols, but di Lord make di heavens.
Honor and majesty dey before am. Strength and beauty dey for im sanctuary.
Give to di Lord, una families of di peoples, give to di Lord glory and strength.
Give to di Lord di glory wey im name deserve. Bring offering and come into im courts.
Worship di Lord for di splendor of holiness. Tremble before am, all di earth.
Say among di nations, “Di Lord reign.” Di world dey firmly established. E no go shake. E go judge di peoples with fairness.
Make di heavens rejoice, and make di earth be glad. Make di sea roar, and all wey full am.
Make di field exult, and all wey dey inside am. Den all di trees of di forest go sing for joy
before di Lord, because e dey come, because e dey come to judge di earth. E go judge di world with righteousness and di peoples with im truth.
Di Lord reign! Make di earth rejoice. Make di many islands be glad.
Clouds and thick darkness dey round am. Righteousness and justice na di foundation of im throne.
Fire dey go before am and burn up im adversaries round about.
Im lightnings light up di world. Di earth see am and tremble.
Di mountains melt like wax at di presence of di Lord, at di presence of di Lord of di whole earth.
Di heavens declare im righteousness, and all di peoples see im glory.
Make all dem wey serve engraved images dey ashamed, dem wey boast for idols. Worship am, all una gods.
Zion hear and rejoice. Di daughters of Judah dey glad because of your judgments, Lord.
Because you, Lord, na Most High over all di earth. You dey exalted far above all gods.
Una wey love di Lord, hate evil. E dey preserve di souls of im holy ones. E dey deliver dem from di hand of di wicked.
Light dey sown for di righteous, and gladness for di upright for heart.
Rejoice for di Lord, una righteous, and give thanks to im holy name.
Oh sing to di Lord new song, because e don do marvelous things. Im right hand and im holy arm don win victory for am.
Di Lord don make im salvation known. E don show im righteousness for di sight of di nations.
E don remember im faithful love and faithfulness to di house of Israel. All di ends of di earth don see di salvation of our God.
Make joyful noise to di Lord, all di earth. Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises.
Sing praises to di Lord with harp, with harp and sound of melody.
With trumpets and sound of horn, make joyful noise before di King, di Lord.
Make di sea roar, and all wey full am, di world and dem wey dey live inside am.
Make di rivers clap dem hands. Make di hills sing for joy together
before di Lord, because e dey come to judge di earth. E go judge di world with righteousness and di peoples with fairness.
Di Lord reign. Make di peoples tremble. E sit above di cherubim. Make di earth shake.
Di Lord great for Zion. E dey high above all di peoples.
Make dem praise your great and awesome name. E holy.
Di King mighty and e love justice. You don establish fairness. You don do justice and righteousness for Jacob.
Exalt di Lord our God and worship for im footstool. E holy.
Moses and Aaron among im priests, and Samuel among dem wey call on im name, dem call on di Lord, and e answer dem.
E speak to dem for di pillar of cloud. Dem keep im testimonies and di statute wey e give dem.
You answer dem, Lord our God. You be God wey forgive dem, though you take vengeance on dem wrongdoing.
Exalt di Lord our God and worship for im holy mountain, because di Lord our God holy.
Make joyful noise to di Lord, all una lands.
Serve di Lord with gladness. Come before im presence with singing.
Know say na di Lord be God. Na im make us, and we belong to am. We be im people and di sheep of im pasture.
Enter im gates with thanksgiving and im courts with praise. Give thanks to am and bless im name.
Because di Lord good. Im faithful love dey forever, and im faithfulness to all generations.
